findings.detail: Static inspection matches affine BMI/glucose/HbA1c equations driven by bounded age/sex and uniform innovations, standardized Gamma BMI innovation, and independent Bernoulli-Gamma excess. Finite Gamma moments plus finite affine combinations establish all polynomial moments. Independent scalar covariance arithmetic reproduces all three declared context moment matrices and positive eigenvalues. Source-context changes in innovation shape are disclosed; they preserve moments and are not source execution.

Target lower bounds independently reproduce BMI 15.595 kg/m^2, glucose 4.044220509655423 mmol/L and HbA1c 4.484363513522538 percent, with unbounded upper tails. Integer age 35-74 and female 0/1 satisfy task support. The separately declared Jansen law has FPG upper support below 7 mmol/L. NGSP response scaling uses multiplier-only covariance conversion; source FPG, source FSG and target serum remain distinguished under explicit transport assumptions.

All 31 marginal quantities and four non-marginal source points, units and locators trace to the admitted packet. All four operations have uptake records. Two Jansen constraints are evaluated as distinct age/sex-adjusted IFCC projections, not pasted into one joint equation. Independent algebra reproduces 0.13 and 2.29 from the actual declared source law. Bao Pearson is 0.6168579820914971 versus reported 0.619, retained as a qualified descriptive check. MIND Spearman is explicitly contextual and unreconstructed; Pearson is not substituted. Unconfirmed interval levels and source overlap remain disclosed without precision weighting.

Independent population OLS gives E1=0.012287162767938344, E2=0.3706013733331096 and E3=0.0023336130586408205 in their task units, within roundoff. E3 also matches the separately derived omitted-excess projection formula and differs from the direct age loading. These are model implications fixed by assumptions, not clinical target observations or independently inferred effects.

The excess component is not estimated diabetes prevalence. Constrained Jansen agreement and the Bao discrepancy do not validate source reconstruction or target applicability. External-estimate, structural and transport uncertainty remain unquantified; fixed-seed draws provide no new clinical evidence.
